eventDetail.scope: With the rapid development of intelligent electric vehicles and the sharp surge in demand for vehicular mobile communications, coupled with the integration of AI, IoT, and V2X technologies, the need for efficient and secure integrated communication-network-IoT systems is growing. WCNIoT 2026 will serve as a high-level international forum focusing on four core fields: Intelligent Wireless Communication Systems, Computer Networks and System Collaboration, IoT and Intelligent System Integration, and Vehicular Mobile Communications. Relevant tracks cover next-generation wireless communication, cloud-edge collaboration, industrial IoT, V2X communication, and green vehicular networks. With keynote speeches and technical sessions arranged to foster academic exchange and industrial application, global researchers and experts will gather to share cutting-edge achievements and discuss key challenges, thereby advancing technological innovation and broad application across related fields.
